cmd: sed -i 's/cargo run -p tokmd -- run --path . --out target\/tokmd-debug/cargo run -p tokmd -- run . --output-dir target\/tokmd-debug/g' docs/debugging.md
sed -i 's/cargo run -p tokmd -- analyze --path . --format json/cargo run -p tokmd -- analyze . --format json/g' docs/debugging.md

sed -i 's/cargo run -p tokmd -- cockpit --base origin\/main --head HEAD --out target\/cockpit-debug/cargo run -p tokmd -- cockpit --base origin\/main --head HEAD --artifacts-dir target\/cockpit-debug/g' docs/debugging.md
sed -i 's/cargo run -p tokmd -- run --path . --out target\/perf-debug/cargo run -p tokmd -- run . --output-dir target\/perf-debug/g' docs/debugging.md

cat << 'EOF' > .jules/runs/librarian_docs_examples_01/result.json
{
  "status": "success",
  "chosen_option": "Option A",
  "findings": "The docs/debugging.md file contained outdated CLI option usage for debugging commands. They were using --path and --out which have been replaced by positional arguments and --output-dir/--artifacts-dir. The CLI commands in the debugging guide were failing to parse.",
  "outcome_type": "PR-ready patch"
}
EOF
